nuances.title: Bemused vs Amused
nuances.meaning: Bemused means puzzled or bewildered, while amused means finding something funny or entertaining.
nuances.nuance_explanation: Although people frequently use 'bemused' as a synonym for mildly amused, it actually describes a state of confused contemplation or mild bewilderment.
nuances.example_usage: The lecturer's strange analogy left the audience thoroughly bemused rather than entertained.
